nodes.title: Retain products as the canonical product vocabulary view
nodes.summary: Resolve ADR-0019's apparent contradiction by retaining products(provider=None) as a vocabulary function while replacing the legacy table-shaped global accessor: the packaged catalogues establish product_id for every provider, so the capability has the same contract in all thirteen countries and passes ADR-0020, whereas the 53 provider-product rows contain 21 distinct combinations of descriptive fields for only twelve product_ids and therefore cannot be collapsed into one faithful canonical metadata row per id. Return the deterministic canonical product-id list globally and the same shaped provider-advertised subset when provider is named, reject an unknown provider, and leave provider-specific catalogue metadata internal. Acceptance tests prove the unscoped result is exactly the twelve sorted canonical ids, every one of the thirteen provider scopes is callable with the same return shape and contains only ids from that vocabulary, provider scoping reflects its packaged product rows, unknown provider handling is loud, and the public result is not a CatalogResult or DataFrame.
